review_notes: GLB v2 structure passes with one mesh, one skin, 24 joints, 15463 triangles, and exact Idle/Casual_Walk clips.
Root animation scale was normalized; the validator also binds the 8,311,199-byte Godot-extracted texture to the identical GLB-embedded PNG bytes.
Browser QA confirmed readable scale, grounded feet, back-facing third-person orientation, and visibly distinct idle/walk poses.
The procedural capsule remains a play-safe fallback if the curated asset is missing or malformed.
